answer.reason: The World Bank WDI indicator SP.POP.TOTL.FE.ZS (Population, female % of total) for Turkmenistan has consistently been slightly above 50% in recent years, reflecting a modest female majority in the population (roughly 50.5–51% per UN-based estimates used by the World Bank). Option B (~50.96%) matches this expected range, while option A (~48.28%) would imply a large male surplus (sex ratio ~107) more typical of Gulf labor-migrant states, which is inconsistent with Turkmenistan's known demographics. Therefore the 2023 value for TKM is B.
